# Topic index

Look a topic up here in your own words, then follow the reference to the section that answers it. Every section of
the book appears under at least one term; a word in italics is another name for a term and points to it.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Find the section for a topic by the words a reader would use.

**Data.** `tools/topic-index.yaml`, which lists terms and aliases for every section.

**Placement.** Report preparation, outside the solver.

**Activation.** Run `gen_topic_index.py`; no solver switch.

**Guarantee / limits.** A term leads to sections that discuss it; it does not say the answer is complete.

**Evidence.** `tools/tests/test_topic_index.py` fails on a term with no section and on a section with no term.
:::
